Opening & Greetings“Good [morning/afternoon], everyone.My name is Wilson Dos Santos, and I’m a Cloud Solution Architect based in São Paulo.Today, I’m excited to share a project that’s been making a real difference in how we handle Java adapter migrations.”🎯 Purpose of the Presentation“The goal of this session is to introduce a tool we developed using .NET 8.0.This tool automates the migration of small Java adapters, helping us save time and reduce manual errors.”🧩 Setting the Context“Let me give you a bit of background.We have a number of legacy Java adapters that need to be migrated to a new architecture.Doing this manually is repetitive, time-consuming, and prone to mistakes.That’s why we built this tool—to streamline and standardize the migration process.”⚙️ How the Tool Works“Here’s how the tool works, step by step:Step 1: Configuration LoadingIt starts by reading configuration files like appsettings.json, extracting the API key and endpoint from the OpenIA41 section.Step 2: Structure DefinitionThen it defines folder and file names—like adapterFolderName and dtoPath.Step 3: Template CloningIt clones a Git repository with a base project and renames folders and files to match the new project—for example, SICTM.BFF.Conta.Step 4: AI-Powered MigrationThis is where it gets exciting.The tool uses AI to migrate resource files, configuration files like adapter.xml, and DTOs.It even generates a README.md file based on the migrated content.”🚀 Key Benefits“So, what do we gain from this?A significant reduction in migration time.Standardized, consistent code output.AI integration to assist with file transformation.And automatic documentation generation.”🔭 What’s Next“Looking ahead, we’re taking this even further:1. Rewriting the Migrator in PythonWe’re transitioning from .NET 8.0 to Python, using the Semantic Kernel SDK to orchestrate AI agents.2. Multi-Agent ArchitectureEach migration step—resources, DTOs, adapter.xml—will be handled by a specialized agent.This allows for parallel processing and scalability, handling multiple requests per second.3. Performance ImprovementsWe expect even faster migrations and better responsiveness for simultaneous adapter requests.”🙏 Closing“That’s the journey so far—and where we’re headed.Thank you so much for your time and attention.I’m happy to take any questions you might have.”

enriched.title: Apresentação de Ferramenta para Migração de Adaptadores Java
enriched.summary: A aula aborda uma apresentação sobre uma ferramenta desenvolvida para automatizar a migração de adaptadores Java legados para uma nova arquitetura. O conteúdo cobre como a ferramenta funciona, seus benefícios, e os próximos passos no desenvolvimento.
mainTopics: Vocabulário técnico em inglês relacionado a migração de software
Uso de expressões para introduzir, enfatizar e concluir ideias
Benefícios da automação com inteligência artificial

vocabulary.definition: To communicate or work together with someone or something.
The size or level of something, especially in comparison to something else.
examples: The code doesn’t support production at scale.
Because of the large scale of this project.

vocabulary.definition: To move from one place to another, often for a specific purpose.
examples: I’m planning to do / carry out this migration in the second week of next month.

vocabulary.definition: Designed to be practical and useful rather than attractive.
An organization or economic activity involved in commercial, industrial, or professional dealings.

grammar.explanation: Key expressions to start, preview, emphasize, and conclude a presentation.
rules: Use 'Good morning and thanks for coming.' to greet the audience.
Use 'The main reason for this is...' to add emphasis.
Conclude with 'That’s everything I want to say.' and invite questions.
examples: Good morning and thanks for coming.
The main reason for this is...
That’s everything I want to say.
commonMistakes: Starting a presentation without greeting the audience.
Ending abruptly without a proper conclusion or invitation for questions.

expressions.expression: Good morning and thanks for coming.
expressions.usage: Usado no início de apresentações formais.
examples: Good morning and thanks for coming.

expressions.meaning: Sinta-se à vontade para fazer perguntas.
expressions.usage: Usado para encorajar a interação com o público durante ou após a apresentação.

expressions.expression: That brings me to the end of my presentation.
expressions.meaning: Isso me leva ao fim da minha apresentação.
expressions.usage: Usado para concluir uma apresentação formal.
examples: That brings me to the end of my presentation.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: 'The main reason for this is ______.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: This phrase is used to emphasize the primary purpose or goal of a task.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct option: 'Good morning and ______ for coming.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'Good morning and thanks for coming.' to greet and thank the audience.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking business environments, presentations often follow a clear structure with greetings, main content, and a conclusion.
Encouraging questions at the end of a presentation is a common practice to engage the audience.
studyTips: Practice the key expressions for starting, previewing, and concluding a presentation in front of a mirror or with a peer.
Focus on pronunciation of technical terms like 'migrate' and 'functional' to sound more confident during presentations.
originalExamples: Good morning and thanks for coming. (Bom dia e obrigado por virem.)
The code doesn’t support production at scale. (O código não suporta produção em escala.)
I’m planning to do / carry out this migration in the second week of next month. (Estou planejando fazer / realizar essa migração na segunda semana do próximo mês.)
Feel free to ask questions. (Sinta-se à vontade para fazer perguntas.)
That’s everything I want to say. (Isso é tudo o que eu quero dizer.)
